examShortTricks: Trick 1: Precipitation set: NaOH + metal salt solutions give coloured hydroxides — Fe3+ brown, Cu2+ pale blue, Zn2+/Al3+ white (dissolve in excess NaOH — amphoteric).
Trick 2: With CO: NaOH + CO → HCOONa (sodium formate) under pressure — the unusual 1-marker.
Trick 3: Uses list: soap manufacture, paper, refining petroleum, textile (mercerisation), lab reagent for CO2 absorption.
